items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: Lucia, better known as Frisco, the Zillophon, he comes up to the box and says, Dad, we're going to start recording tomorrow.

ctx.x: She was in early movies, in silent movies?

When I was a youngster, before I was married. And Charlie played a little clarinet. In fact, he gave me the clarinet and I sold it. I sold it for $15. He says, who wants a clarinet? I said, I'll take it. He was trying to play the clarinet. But anybody that's like Jack Benny. Jack Benny always was down in the pit with us. I mean, down in the cellar. And we used to joke because he went on after the dogs. And he says to me, don't you think they ought to sweep the stage before I come on? We got to be friends. We…
Frisco, the guy who wrote Check It and Break It?
